title: Draft cross-chain bridge optimizer architecture spec
description: Write docs/architecture/p07-bridge-optimizer.md: route scorer, bridge allowlist registry, storage-proof verifier (Axiom/Herodotus), async settlement engine, slippage caps, and the agent solver loop. Map the catalog gates (bridge_whitelist, slippage_cap) to enforcing components and describe the localized-crunch fulfillment pattern from the A-SINC deep spec. Acceptance: spec enumerates every async failure mode (proof expiry, bridge depeg, reorg) with a recovery path.

title: Define interfaces for bridge routing contracts
description: Create onchain/src/p07/interfaces/IBridgeRouter.sol, IStorageProofVerifier.sol and IAllowlistRegistry.sol with NatSpec and fixed signatures for scoring, proof submission and settlement. Acceptance: compile under solc 0.8.24; every cross-rollup handoff the agents perform is declared exactly once.

title: Model bridge routing economics and fee capture
description: Write docs/economics/p07-bridge-economics.md: route scoring function, cross-rollup premium capture model, 10 bps fee to Treasury, and risk budgets (min capital $100, max_alloc_pct 0.20). Acceptance: the scoring function is validated against synthetic route fixtures; fee flow traces to Treasury end-to-end.

title: Scaffold p07 repo layout and interfaces
description: Create onchain/src/p07/, src/sincor2/defi/p07_bridge/, tests/pytest/test_p07_*, configs/agents/p07-bridge-agent.yaml; wire interfaces from the spec. Acceptance: tree exists, imports resolve, solc 0.8.24 compiles the interface set with zero errors.

title: Starter bridge router and solver agent boilerplate
description: Write BridgeRouter skeleton (ReentrancyGuard, SafeERC20, non-bricking try/catch on external bridge calls) and the Python solver agent skeleton with TOA hooks and structured logging. Acceptance: compiles under solc 0.8.24, agent boots with dummy config, stub test green.

title: Build cross-bridge route scorer
description: Implement the route scoring engine over allowlisted bridges: latency, fee, depth and historical reliability inputs with a single normalized score, plus a Python reference in src/sincor2/defi/p07_bridge/scorer.py. Acceptance: scores are deterministic and reproduce the reference within 1e-9 across 1k fixture routes; scoring rejects any bridge not on the allowlist before any other computation.

title: Build storage-proof verification for async settlement
description: Implement the Axiom/Herodotus storage-proof verifier that lets agents settle trustlessly later across isolated L2 rollups, with an ultra-light client parser for agent-side proof checks. Acceptance: valid proofs verify and settle; expired or malformed proofs revert; proof parsing adds no more than the documented latency budget.

title: Build bridge allowlist registry
description: Implement the onchain allowlist registry with admin-governed bridge registration, per-bridge risk caps, and revocation. Acceptance: routing reverts for any non-allowlisted bridge; revocation immediately excludes the bridge from new routes while in-flight proofs settle safely.

title: Build async cross-rollup settlement engine
description: Implement the settlement engine: fulfill via private local pools on the destination rollup when a localized crunch is detected, then settle trustlessly via storage proofs later. Acceptance: full detect-fulfill-prove-settle cycle completes on L2 forks; funds are never released without a verified proof.

title: Implement slippage caps and quote guardrails
description: Implement the slippage_cap gate: per-route and per-bridge slippage ceilings enforced onchain and re-checked by the agent before submission. Acceptance: routes exceeding the cap revert onchain and are skipped agent-side; caps are YAML-configurable with safe defaults.

title: Build bridge solver agent loop
description: Build the Python solver agent: monitors localized crunches (e.g. stablecoin premium on one rollup), scores routes, fulfills via local pools, submits proofs. Acceptance: agent completes a full cycle on test fixtures with TOA telemetry and error handling with backoff.

title: Handle bridge optimizer edge cases
description: Handle proof expiry, bridge depeg/halt, reorgs, and destination-chain congestion with graceful degradation. Acceptance: each case has a dedicated test and a one-page incident doc in docs/ops/p07-edge-cases.md.

title: Unit tests for route scoring and gates
description: Write tests/pytest/test_p07_unit.py covering scorer determinism, allowlist enforcement, slippage caps and proof verifier happy/error paths. Acceptance: 100% pass; non-allowlisted bridge routes asserted to revert.

title: Integration tests for async bridge flow
description: Write tests/pytest/test_p07_integration.py: agent scores, fulfills, submits proof, settles on local L2 fixtures. Acceptance: full async cycle green; proof-expiry path covered.

title: Fuzz and invariant tests for settlement safety
description: Fuzz scoring inputs and proof payloads; assert invariants: no settlement without valid proof, no routing via non-allowlisted bridge, slippage caps never exceeded. Acceptance: 10k+ fuzz runs green; counterexamples fixed and recorded.

title: Multi-rollup fork simulation of bridge routing
description: Simulate localized crunches (stablecoin premium on one rollup) against forks, run the solver end-to-end. Acceptance: report in tests/reports/p07-fork-sim.md with premium captured, fees to Treasury, and reproducible block pins.

title: Audit-prep package for bridge optimizer
description: Assemble docs/audits/p07/: frozen code, NatSpec, threat model (fake proofs, allowlist governance capture, depeg), gate enforcement map. Acceptance: complete contract inventory and proof-trust assumptions documented.

title: Remediate bridge optimizer audit findings
description: Fix all findings with priority to proof-verification and allowlist issues; each fix links to its finding ID. Acceptance: zero open high/medium findings; regression tests for each fix pass.

title: Gas optimization for bridge contracts
description: Optimize scoring, proof submission and settlement paths without weakening gates. Acceptance: before/after gas report in docs/audits/p07/gas.md with zero behavioral change in tests.

title: Technical docs for bridge optimizer
description: Write docs/p07-bridge-optimizer.md: contract reference, proof flow, scoring function, gate semantics. Acceptance: a new builder can run the solver from the docs alone; all references resolve.

title: Agent YAML config and ops runbook
description: Write configs/agents/p07-bridge-agent.yaml and docs/ops/p07-runbook.md (deploy, monitor, depeg response, proof-expiry handling). Acceptance: agent boots from YAML; runbook covers depeg and proof-expiry incidents.

title: Dashboard and monitoring hooks
description: Expose route scores, proof latency, settlement backlog, gate states and Treasury fee accrual in the status feed. Acceptance: feed reports real values or 'unknown', never fabricated 'healthy'.

title: Testnet deploy scripts for bridge optimizer
description: Write scripts/deploy/p07/ deploying to Base Sepolia with a minimal bridge allowlist and live routing disabled. Acceptance: idempotent scripts; addresses and allowlist recorded; live path reverts.

title: Mainnet readiness checklist for bridge optimizer
description: Write docs/ops/p07-mainnet-checklist.md: audit sign-off, allowlist governance, proof-oracle trust assumptions, key custody. Acceptance: checklist signed off by the auditor task; no mainnet action without allowlist quorum.
